entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello? I'm calling about an order I received last month. I need to make a return.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Judy. I can definitely help you with that. Could I please have your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Sarah Mills, and the order is VF-92104.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Trail Helmet. You'd like to return that item?
Okay, **no problem** at all. Let's see here... Our policy allows for returns within **90 days** of delivery, so you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, that's great. I wasn't sure if I had missed the deadline.

Not at all! And I see you're a VIP member with us, we really appreciate your business. As a thank you, I've waived any return shipping fees. I'm sending a pre-paid **return label** to your email on file right now. Does that sound good?
That's perfect. Thank you so much, Judy. That was very easy.
You are very welcome, Sarah! Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll process your full refund. Is there anything else I can help with today?
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer!
